founderAnswers.topic: How the T008 units are launched
founderAnswers.question: How are the T008 units launched?
founderAnswers.terms: A root launcher with a T008 mode starts the driver as braidlab in its own Background session (launchctl asuser), as the SPEC-065 headless mode does for T009. The orchestrator runs its check automatically (passwordless sudo rule for check only); the owner runs `sudo ... run` in Terminal.app with the password and types the quota readings.
